memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dyslipidaemia. Asymptomatic, BMI 27, BP 128/82, cardiovascular exam normal. Plans: fasting lipid profile, LFT, CK; start atorvastatin 10 mg HS; lifestyle advice.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 3.8 mmol/L (ref <2.6), HDL 1.2 mmol/L (ref >1.0), TG 2.2 mmol/L (ref <1.7). LFT: ALT 22 U/L (ref 7-56), AST 20 U/L (ref 10-40). CK 210 U/L (ref 30-200).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have felt mild muscle soreness in my thighs after climbing stairs, not painful, no dark urine.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dyslipidaemia, stable. Muscle discomfort noted, CK mildly elevated on prior labs. Exam: no muscle tenderness, power normal. Plan: repeat lipids, LFT, CK; continue atorvastatin, advise hydration.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 2.9 mmol/L, HDL 1.3 mmol/L, TG 1.8 mmol/L. LFT: ALT 24 U/L, AST 21 U/L. CK 340 U/L (ref 30-200).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dyslipidaemia. CK risen to 340 U/L, patient reports ongoing thigh discomfort. Exam: no weakness. Assessment: statin-associated myalgia likely. Plan: stop atorvastatin, start rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, recheck CK in 4 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 2.2 mmol/L, HDL 1.4 mmol/L, TG 1.5 mmol/L. LFT: ALT 20 U/L, AST 19 U/L. CK 180 U/L (ref 30-200).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dyslipidaemia. Lipids improved, CK normal, no muscle symptoms. Exam normal. Plan: consider adding fenofibrate if TG remains >1.7; continue rosuvastatin, repeat lipids in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rosuvastatin 10 mg OD. Fenofibrate 145 mg OD added.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2026-12-01 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05) for lipid review.
